directories.description: SMART Verifiable IPS for Pilgrimage's IG Publisher AST, INGESTED here although the IG's source is not (owner, 2026-10-04: an IG's semi-static KG may stay remote, and its AST is still ingested into the folio). Read from the branch family cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/ on the IG's own repository (litlfred/smart-ips-pilgrimage), one branch per IG package id; this IG's member is cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/smart.who.int.ips-pilgrimage. Restored by fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh; absent from the checkout by design. Bean nr5p.

The artefact index for smart-ips-pilgrimage. `index.json`, `menu.json`, `releases.json` and `package.tgz` are NOT COMMITTED: fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes them at publish from the IG's AST (`builtAtPublish`, fhir-harness#124). `ig-identity.json` and the README stay committed. Bean nr5p.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Built from the IG's own AST, and GENERATED -- fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes this index at publish, a person does not edit or commit it (fhir-harness#124). A hand edit here silently changes what this repository claims upstream published, and `check:materialized-fixity` is what catches one that happened.

directories.description: How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: today `dak.coverage.smart-ips-pilgrimage.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. GENERATED at publish by the DAK layer's `gen-document-kinds.ts` (`bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds`; declared `builtAtPublish`, because the index it reads is built at publish too, fhir-harness#124) into this directory, and not committed, because the report is about this IG (folio-assistant#2598). Bean nr5p.

The reader-facing pages, generated from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json` by `smart-ips-pilgrimage:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts`). These are the artefact pages of smart-ips-pilgrimage's IG site (`igSite`, bean `mftp`): they build into smart-ips-pilgrimage's own IG site at `/smart-ips-pilgrimage/` under the IG's menu. Generated at publish, never authored or committed.

smart-ips-pilgrimage's bibliography: one folio-reference/v1 CSL-JSON entry per cited work, `<key>.json`. The IG is one document with one bibliography page, the KG Bibliography the site publishes (`en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/`, the IG menu's Bibliography item); the IG pages hold no reference lists of their own, and each in-text citation links to its entry there as `en/folio-assistant-core/bibliography/#ref-<key>`. smart-base's `check:ig-citations` fails on a citation with no entry, a page reference list, or a reference-section link to a work this directory does not hold

The gettext side of this IG's text, one directory per target locale (ar, es, fr, ru, zh; the source is en): .pot templates extracted by input/scripts/translation-pot.ts (the harness's own extractors) from the narrative pages in input/pagecontent/ and the BPMN in input/business-processes/, and the .po catalogues translated from them, each with a translation-node/v1 manifest. Agent translations are unofficial (official: false, generatedBy agent) until a person signs them off. FHIR resources are not here: they use CodeSystem supplements in input/fsh/translations/<locale>.fsh.
